questions: Are the upward eye movements and eyelid closures involuntary?
Do these episodes occur in distinct attacks with normal eye position between them?
During an episode, do you remain fully conscious and able to respond normally?
Did these symptoms begin suddenly or worsen after starting, stopping, or increasing a medication?
Have you taken an antipsychotic medication recently?
Have you taken an anti-nausea medication such as metoclopramide or prochlorperazine recently?
Do the episodes involve painful or sustained movements of your neck, jaw, tongue, or other muscles?
Can you voluntarily stop the eye movements or eyelid closure when asked?
Are the episodes brought on by stress, fatigue, bright light, or looking in a particular direction?
Do the episodes stop completely while you are asleep?
Have you ever lost awareness, had limb jerking, or been confused afterward?
Have you experienced new weakness, numbness, difficulty speaking, severe headache, fever, or neck stiffness?
Do you have double vision or loss of vision during or between episodes?
Have you had similar episodes in the past?
Do you have Parkinson disease or another movement disorder?
Have you recently reduced or stopped a medication used to treat Parkinson disease or another movement disorder?
